mainEntity.name: Why do some window framing projects cost so much more than others?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cost varies with wall structure, header size, material repairs, and whether the opening is new or a resize of an existing opening. Local Denver pricing for framing work can range widely depending on scope, and structural changes usually cost more than a basic opening. If the wall has water damage or needs reframing, expect the price to increase.
acceptedAnswer.description: Price changes with wall structure, header work, repairs, and permit-related complexity. Bigger structural changes and damaged framing usually cost more than a simple opening.
